{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
penguins = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length within each island-species group
mean_flipper_by_island_species = penguins.groupby(['island', 'species'])['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Get total counts per island
island_counts = penguins.groupby('island').size()
island_proportions = island_counts / island_counts.sum()

# Compute adjusted mean flipper length for each species
species_means_adjusted = {}
for species in penguins['species'].unique():
    species_data = penguins[penguins['species'] == species]
    island_means = species_data.groupby('island')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    # Weight by overall island proportions
    adjusted_mean = (island_means * island_proportions).sum()
    species_means_adjusted[species] = adjusted_mean

# Convert to Series
species_means_adjusted = pd.Series(species_means_adjusted)

# Find species with highest adjusted mean
best_species = species_means_adjusted.idxmax()
best_value = species_means_adjusted.max()

# Print all adjusted means
print("Adjusted mean flipper length by species:")
print(species_means_adjusted)

# Also print the raw means for comparison
raw_means = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print("\nRaw mean flipper length by species:")
print(raw_means)"}
